name: SnipShip – Shipping Label Cropper
description: Crop mixed courier label PDFs into clean 4×6 printer-ready labels. All processing happens on your device. No uploads.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src https://snipship.co.uk; object-src 'none'; frame-src blob:;
